+"""
+Loads image bytes from an image reference that a user may have set
+(cut.image_path, character image URLs, style references, ...).
+
+Never makes an HTTP request to the address in the reference. Only these are
+accepted:
+- data: URLs (decoded in place)
+- relative storage paths ("{schema}/{identifier}/{uuid}.png")
+- full URLs under settings.STORAGE_HOST (mapped back to the storage path)
+
+Everything else (any other http(s)/ftp/file/... URL) is refused, so a user
+cannot make the backend fetch an address inside our network.
+"""
+import base64
+import binascii
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+
+def storage_path_for(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Returns the storage object path for `ref`, or None if `ref` does not
+    point into our storage."""
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    ref = ref.strip()
+    parts = urlsplit(ref)
+    if parts.scheme or parts.netloc or ref.startswith("/") or ref.startswith("\\"):
+        host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+        if not host or not ref.startswith(host + "/"):
+            return None
+        path = urlsplit(ref[len(host) + 1:]).path
+        path = unquote(path)
+    else:
+        path = unquote(parts.path)
+    path = path.lstrip("/")
+    if not path or "\\" in path or any(seg in ("", ".", "..") for seg in path.split("/")):
+        return None
+    if urlsplit(path).scheme:
+        return None
+    return path
+
+
+def decode_data_url(ref: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    try:
+        header, encoded = ref.split(",", 1)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if ";base64" in header.lower():
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+        return unquote(encoded).encode("latin-1")
+    except (binascii.Error, ValueError, UnicodeEncodeError):
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Returns the bytes of the image `ref` points to, or None."""
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    if ref.strip().lower().startswith("data:"):
+        return decode_data_url(ref.strip())
+    path = storage_path_for(ref)
+    if path is None:
+        print(f"[ImageSource] Refusing to load image from non-storage address: {ref[:100]}")
+        return None
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    return storage.download_image(path)

+"""Exports say which cuts they left out: missing.txt in the ZIP and the
+X-Missing-Cuts header on both formats."""

+

+

+NOT_AN_IMAGE = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(b"not a png").decode()
+
+
+def make_episode(client, h):
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert project.status_code == 200, project.text
+    episode = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project.json()["id"], "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert episode.status_code == 200, episode.text
+    return episode.json()["id"]
+
+
+def add_cut(client, h, episode_id, order, image_path=None):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": order})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    if image_path is not None:
+        r2 = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{r.json()['id']}", headers=h, json={"image_path": image_path})
+        assert r2.status_code == 200, r2.text
+
+
+def put_in_storage(path, body):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    from tests.lab_env import FakeMinio
+
+    FakeMinio.objects.setdefault(settings.MINIO_BUCKET, {})[path] = body
+
+
+def export(client, h, episode_id, fmt):
+    return client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+
+
+def zip_contents(r):
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:
+        return {name: zf.read(name) for name in zf.namelist()}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()

+    h = signup(client)

+    put_in_storage("cuts/ep/one.png", PNG)
+    add_cut(client, h, episode_id, 1, "cuts/ep/one.png")
+    add_cut(client, h, episode_id, 2)
+    add_cut(client, h, episode_id, 3, "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/")
+    add_cut(client, h, episode_id, 4, DATA_URL)

+    assert len(boards) == 1
+
+
+# --- episode export ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def make_episode(client, h):
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert project.status_code == 200, project.text
+    episode = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project.json()["id"], "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert episode.status_code == 200, episode.text
+    return episode.json()["id"]
+
+
+def add_cut(client, h, episode_id, order, image_path):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": order})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cut_id = r.json()["id"]
+    r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut_id}", headers=h, json={"image_path": image_path})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return cut_id
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_export_does_not_fetch_internal_urls(client, fmt):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h)
+    add_cut(client, h, episode_id, 1, "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/")
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 400
+
+
+def test_export_zip_keeps_storage_and_data_images_and_skips_internal_urls(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h)
+    put_in_storage("cuts/ep/one.png", b"from-storage")
+    add_cut(client, h, episode_id, 1, storage_url("cuts/ep/one.png"))
+    add_cut(client, h, episode_id, 2, DATA_URL)
+    add_cut(client, h, episode_id, 3, "http://127.0.0.1:8000/admin")
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:
+        contents = {name: zf.read(name) for name in zf.namelist()}
+    images = [body for name, body in contents.items() if name.endswith(".png")]
+    assert sorted(images) == sorted([b"from-storage", PNG])
+    assert contents["missing.txt"] == b"3\n"
